chunks: From Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Among what Allah, the Mighty and Majestic and Exalted, whispered to Musa (peace be upon him) was: 'O Musa! Those who draw near to Me do not draw near with anything like piety (war') from My prohibitions. So I have granted them the Gardens of Eden, not sharing anyone else with them.'

key_terms.الْوَرَعِ: Piety, God-consciousness, and detachment from prohibitions
key_terms.لَا أُشْرِكُ: I do not share (exclusivity of reward)

ai.seo_question: What is the best way to draw near to God according to the divine whisper to Musa?
ai.summary: In this famous *munajat* (divine whisper) recorded in *Al-Kafi*, God declares that *war'* (piety and guarding against the prohibited) is the supreme form of worship, surpassing even ritual acts. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on moral vigilance as the foundation of spiritual proximity, promising exclusive entry into *Jannat 'Adn* (Gardens of Eden) for those who strictly observe divine boundaries.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Among what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Whispered to Musa<sup>as</sup> with, was: “O Musa<sup>as</sup>! Those coming near Me<sup>azwj</sup> do not come near Me<sup>azwj</sup> with (anything) like the devoutness from keeping away from My<sup>azwj</sup> Prohibitions. So I<sup>azwj</sup> have sold to them the Gardens of Eden (of ever-lasting Bliss), not Participating anyone else along with them’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from those whom he has mentioned (in his book) from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Of the things that Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, spoke to Moses one was as follows: ‘O Moses, of those who seek nearness to Me no one is like the ones who restrain from what I have made unlawful. I, therefore, open for them the garden of Eden and will not allow anyone else to share it with them.’”
